faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does CivicConnect route my report?
faq.a1: Our AI model analyzes your description and uploaded photos, detects the category, and assigns it directly to the responsible municipal department.
faq.q2: Do I need to create an account to track issues?
faq.a2: No, you can track any complaint instantly using its unique reference number (e.g. CC-2026-A1B2) on the Track page.
faq.q3: Can I report in my regional language?
faq.a3: Yes! You can report in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Odia, or English.
faq.q4: How do I know when an issue is resolved?
faq.a4: You will receive email notifications, dashboard alerts, and can inspect before/after verification photos.
